newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moulin says in Nasdaq listing plan.
newsitem.headline: Moulin says in Nasdaq listing plan.

text.p: Moulin International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its plans for possible listing of the company's shares on the U.S. Nasdaq market were in preliminary stages.

"The company has not contracted with any underwriters in respect of the potential listing and has not yet determined whether any offering will consist of issue of new shares and or sale of existing shares of the company," the statement said.
In June, the optical products maker said it was in discussions with potential financial advisers on listing American Depositary Receipts but that terms had not yet been finalised.
Moulin shares were untraded at HK$4.525 in early trade.
